title: Thai Perilla Confit Bites
description: Moist and flavorful Thai-inspired bites filled with confit and perilla. Perfect as an appetizer or snack.

ingredients.name: French bread crumbs
ingredients.notes: gluten-free bread crumbs can be substituted

ingredients.name: Nourishing seeds
ingredients.notes: chia seeds or flaxseeds work well

instructions: Rinse the perilla leaves and pat dry with a paper towel.
In a food processor, combine confit, bread crumbs, and nourishing seeds. Process until well combined.
Add chewy sugar if using and process until sugar is evenly distributed.
Stuff each perilla leaf with the confit mixture and secure with a toothpick.
Place the bites on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the perilla leaves are crispy.
